webDevelopment.overviewHeading: Websites Built for Real Business Impact, Not Just Aesthetics.
overviewParagraphs: Your website is the digital storefront, primary marketing engine, and central credibility benchmark of your brand. In today's competitive landscape, visitors form an impression within milliseconds. A slow, outdated, or confusing website directly leaks leads, customers, and revenue.

At Legacy IT, we engineer web solutions that combine cutting-edge technology with intuitive human-centric design. From lightning-fast corporate websites to complex e-commerce hubs, we build clean, maintainable, and scalable platforms that drive conversions.
Every line of code is optimized for Core Web Vitals, organic search discoverability, and frictionless mobile usability across every device and browser.

faqs.question: How long does it typically take to build a website?
faqs.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope. A dedicated landing page can be completed in 5-7 business days, while comprehensive corporate websites or e-commerce stores typically take 2-5 weeks from discovery to final deployment.

faqs.question: Will my website be mobile-friendly and optimized for Google?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Every website we build is fully responsive across all screen dimensions and includes semantic SEO foundations, meta tags, OpenGraph previews, XML sitemaps, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

faqs.question: Can I update text and images myself after launch?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We configure user-friendly CMS management systems or simple admin interfaces so your team can easily modify text, update photos, add blog posts, or manage products without needing to code.

faqs.question: What technologies and frameworks do you use?
faqs.answer: We prioritize modern, robust stacks including React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and scalable cloud hosting platforms like Vercel and AWS, ensuring maximum security, blistering speed, and effortless scaling.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer flexible ongoing maintenance plans covering continuous security updates, cloud backups, speed audits, uptime monitoring, and priority technical assistance.

processSteps.description: We build native or cross-platform code, integrate backend endpoints, and run automated device test suites.

processSteps.name: Deliver
processSteps.description: We coordinate beta testing via TestFlight and Google Play Internal Testing, then launch publicly to the stores.

faqs.question: Should I build a native app or a cross-platform app?
faqs.answer: For most modern businesses, cross-platform frameworks (like React Native) offer 95%+ identical performance to native code while saving 40-50% in development and maintenance costs. If your app requires extremely deep hardware manipulation or specialized 3D graphics, native Swift/Kotlin may be recommended.

faqs.question: Do you handle App Store and Google Play submissions?
faqs.answer: Yes, entirely. We prepare the developer accounts, build signed production binaries, write store listing assets, and handle the formal review and approval process with both Apple and Google.

faqs.question: Can my app function when the user has no internet?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design with an offline-first philosophy, utilizing local SQLite or Realm databases to store cached data and queue actions until connectivity is restored.

faqs.question: How long does a mobile app project usually take?
faqs.answer: A standard MVP application typically takes 4-8 weeks from discovery to beta testing. More complex applications with extensive backend integrations or multi-role permissions may take 8-14 weeks.

faqs.question: What happens when Apple or Google release new OS versions?
faqs.answer: We provide ongoing maintenance contracts to ensure your application remains fully compatible with new iOS and Android releases, updated screen aspect ratios, and revised privacy guidelines.

faqs.question: How do I send my raw video footage to your team?
faqs.answer: You can upload your raw camera files, screen recordings, and audio tracks to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or WeTransfer. We work with all common video formats (MP4, MOV, ProRes, B-RAW, Sony XAVC, etc.).

faqs.question: Do you supply licensed music and sound effects?
faqs.answer: Yes. We include fully licensed commercial music tracks and professional sound effects with every project, ensuring your videos can be monetized on YouTube and promoted across social media without copyright claims.

faqs.question: Can you provide both vertical (Reels) and widescreen (YouTube) formats?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can produce multi-aspect exports: 16:9 for YouTube and websites, 9:16 for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok, and 1:1 or 4:5 for feed advertising.

faqs.question: What is your typical turnaround time for video edits?
faqs.answer: Social media Reels and Shorts are typically delivered within 24 to 48 hours. Long-form YouTube videos and corporate promotional edits usually take 3 to 5 business days for initial draft delivery.

digitalMarketing.description: We help businesses strengthen their online presence, reach the right audience, and build meaningful connections through digital marketing and search engine optimization.
digitalMarketing.overviewHeading: Growth Marketing Grounded in Data, Rankings, and Real Revenue.
overviewParagraphs: Having a world-class digital product means very little if your target customers cannot find you. Effective digital marketing is not about collecting meaningless vanity impressions; it is about attracting qualified, high-intent prospective clients who are actively seeking what you offer.

At Legacy IT, we craft cohesive growth systems combining Organic Search Engine Optimization (SEO) with data-driven social media and paid advertising strategies. We analyze search intent, resolve technical crawling hurdles, write search-dominant content, and optimize every funnel stage.
With completely transparent monthly reporting, you see precisely how rankings improve, where traffic originates, and how marketing spend translates into measurable revenue.

deliverables.description: Holistic search optimization engineered to secure sustainable, compounding top positions on Google for high-value business terms.

deliverables.title: On-Page SEO
deliverables.description: Granular optimization of headings, meta tags, schema markup, image alt attributes, and content structure for maximum relevance.

deliverables.title: Technical SEO
deliverables.description: Deep architectural fixes ensuring search spiders can seamlessly crawl, index, and render your website with zero roadblocks.

deliverables.title: Social Media Management
deliverables.description: End-to-end community stewardship, content scheduling, and audience engagement across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

deliverables.description: Targeted, demographic-focused paid social campaigns engineered to capture qualified leads and amplify brand awareness.

deliverables.description: High-authority editorial and technical copywriting that establishes your company as the premier subject matter expert in your industry.

deliverables.description: Continuous technical refinements and local citation management to ensure your business dominates relevant regional searches.

digitalMarketing.whyHeading: Why Choose Legacy IT for Digital Growth?

whyReasons.title: Revenue Over Vanity Metrics
whyReasons.description: We focus on qualified leads, phone calls, form fills, and sales—not superficial impression counts that don't impact your balance sheet.

whyReasons.title: Strict White-Hat Practices
whyReasons.description: We adhere strictly to Google's Helpful Content Guidelines, protecting your digital assets from volatile algorithm penalties.

whyReasons.title: Technical & Creative Synergy
whyReasons.description: We bring engineers and creative marketers together, solving technical crawling errors while writing compelling sales copy.

whyReasons.title: Transparent Reporting
whyReasons.description: You get direct access to real-time dashboards and clear monthly reporting meetings showing exact ROI and keyword movements.

processSteps.name: Plan & Create
processSteps.description: We map out a 6-month SEO optimization calendar, establish ad campaign architectures, and produce target content outlines.

processSteps.name: Execute
processSteps.description: We implement on-page enhancements, resolve technical errors, publish optimized content, and launch targeted ad sets.

processSteps.name: Deliver
processSteps.description: We analyze conversion metrics, refine bids, track keyword shifts, and present detailed monthly growth reports.

faqs.question: How long does it take to see tangible results from SEO?
faqs.answer: SEO is a compounding organic growth asset. Initial indexation improvements and keyword movement typically emerge within 60 to 90 days. Significant, sustainable traffic and lead generation leaps generally become evident around months 4 to 6.

faqs.question: What is the difference between On-Page and Technical SEO?
faqs.answer: On-Page SEO focuses on human and bot-facing content—keyword integration, headings, readability, and meta tags. Technical SEO deals with underlying server architecture—page load speed, mobile responsive rendering, SSL security, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt rules.

faqs.question: Do you manage paid ad campaigns as well as organic SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in integrated growth. While SEO builds long-term, zero-marginal-cost organic equity, Google Search PPC and Meta ads provide immediate customer acquisition from day one.

faqs.question: How do you track and report our marketing ROI?
faqs.answer: We configure Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and custom conversion tracking tags. You receive monthly reports breaking down traffic sources, cost-per-acquisition, keyword position changes, and inbound lead volume.

faqs.question: Can you collaborate with our existing internal team?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can function as your full-service digital marketing department, or serve as specialized consultants partnering directly with your internal marketing and sales staff.
